content:
Maria: quick ask — partners sent a new CSV of hourly supply/spot/commit prices, looks like some SKUs have very short commit windows (7d). can we fold this into cost model before tomorrow's price review?
Jon: can you paste an example row? want to see fields we need for cost-sim.
Maria: pasted below (from vendor):
```csv
sku,region,instance_family,spot_hourly,reserved_hourly,commit_tenor_days,eviction_rate_pct,min_commit_hours
zenith-v100,us-west1,rtx_v100,0.12,0.08,7,6,100
volt-a100,us-east1,a100,0.45,0.30,30,1.2,500
core-gpu,eu-west1,a10,0.09,0.06,14,10,50
```
Liam: ok useful. questions: (1) are `reserved_hourly` invoice price or list price? (2) `min_commit_hours` how strictly enforced?
Maria: vendor answered — reserved is invoice price post-rebate. min_commit enforced via billing ledger (they prorate but charge floor).
Sophie: that `eviction_rate_pct` is huge for core-gpu in eu. do we have historical volatility samples? would like 95th pct eviction to scenario test.
Jon: finance note — when reserved is invoice price we should model opportunity cost vs marketplace listing fee. also need conversion credit parameters for early-termination.
Maria: vendor also provided API to query near-term supply signals: `/v1/supply/{sku}?window=24h` (they want partner token). marketplace-bot: new attachment uploaded: https://files.redwood.ai/partners/2155556666/zenith-sample.csv :thumbsup:
Liam: operational ask — for Dedicated vs Hosted routing, we need per-region latency premium and commit signal mapped to capacity buckets. can product add `latency_premium_ms` column?
Maria: asked them for `latency_premium_ms` and `list_price_currency`. awaiting reply.
Sophie: for cost model inputs I'll need: sku, region, commit_tenor_days, reserved_hourly, spot_hourly, eviction_rate_pct, min_commit_hours, early_termination_credit_pct. prefer as one CSV.
Jon: also record who to credit for marketplace listing fee (partner vs marketplace). that affects net unit economics.
Maria: action items:
- Maria: consolidate vendor CSVs into canonical schema by EOD and push to /shared/partners/cost-inputs
- Sophie: add eviction scenarios (p10/p50/p90) to cost sim using their `eviction_rate_pct` as baseline
- Liam: wire up supply API to autoscaler testbed (token handled by partnerships svc)
- Jon: estimate reserve vs spot blended unit economics for next Q forecast
Liam: +1 on deadlines. tagging @SRE later if supply API test needs creds.
Maria: thanks — will follow up when I have the canonical CSV. :calendar:
